research.name: TermDOM
research.note: Renders real HTML, CSS and DOM nodes to terminal cells, so TUIs are written like web pages and repaint on mutation.

effects: HTML and CSS rendered to a terminal character grid through a real DOM and CSS cascade
automatic repaint on DOM mutation with no render call
CSS box model, flexbox and grid layout computed in whole terminal cells (Klondike solitaire board with stacked cards)
